## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the reason.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` when browser behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run audit:dependencies`
- [ ] Marketplace payload rebuilt and validated when packaging changed
- [ ] Generated workbook validated when reporting changed
- [ ] Cursor, Claude, Codex, and Copilot manifests remain aligned
- [ ] README and support documentation match actual behavior

## Accessibility and evidence

State whether the change affects confirmed, review, blocker, or guided/manual classifications. Include failure-case coverage and avoid treating heuristics as conformance proof.

## Security and data handling

Confirm that no credentials, customer URLs, report workbooks, screenshots, or private page content are committed.
